answer: Sybil resistance is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. To vote, an agent locks a bond and climbs the summit of a reputation ladder, and each ballot is cross-checked against a mirror of signed attestations so one key cannot pose as many. Splitting into a thousand wallets needs a thousand funded bonds: the attacker pays per fake identity rather than minting free names. If two keys present the same crystal of forged history, slashing burns their whole stake, so a fake majority costs locked capital the attacker forfeits, far more than honest mining earns.
